capability_boundary.ai_manager_may: Inspect validated evidence, identify suspicious patterns or uncertainty, and request at most one relevant analysis weapon.
ai_manager_must_not: calculate position sizing or financial exposure
set TP, SL, slippage, or TWAP
authorize, construct, sign, submit, or broadcast transactions
make final trading or financial decisions

SUSPICIOUS_EARLY.trigger: Validated early-token evidence contains concentration, coordinated-funding, developer-history, or transaction-timing anomalies.
SUSPICIOUS_EARLY.selection_rule: Choose at most one weapon that best investigates the strongest validated anomaly. Never call all candidates.

UNCERTAIN_OR_CONFLICTED_HISTORY.trigger: Historical coverage is incomplete, stale, unavailable, or contradictory.
UNCERTAIN_OR_CONFLICTED_HISTORY.selection_rule: Call one weapon only if it can resolve a specific testable uncertainty; otherwise return UNAVAILABLE/UNCERTAIN without a call.

POSITIVE_EVIDENCE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.trigger: Validated evidence is favorable but one material claim needs independent analysis.
POSITIVE_EVIDENCE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.selection_rule: Choose one weapon to verify the highest-impact unconfirmed claim. Prefer on-chain evidence over narrative-only evidence.

DOWNSIDE_OR_DISTRIBUTION_WARNING.trigger: Validated evidence shows liquidity deterioration, developer selling, unusual sell velocity, or suspicious distribution.
DOWNSIDE_OR_DISTRIBUTION_WARNING.selection_rule: Choose one weapon that best investigates the warning. Never interpret its output as a sell instruction.

MATURE_OR_REVIVAL_PATTERN.trigger: A mature or previously inactive token shows a validated change in activity, wallet quality, or market participation.
MATURE_OR_REVIVAL_PATTERN.selection_rule: Choose one weapon only when its inputs exist and its result can materially reduce uncertainty.
